candidate.name: Thermally powered identical coupled LCE springs

source.access: Full primary XML; MathML absolute-value mfenced verified. CC BY 4.0.

candidate.status: Implementable published four-state reduced ODE; modest priority, physical and literature limitations explicit.
candidate.not_six_states: Thermal field eliminated in published Eq. 14. Reintroducing independent temperature variables without deriving full source closure would change the model.

equations.domain: A>0, k>=0, a1>0; s=0 evaluated by limits. Source contraction alpha<0 and gradient beta>0.

source_example.initial_position_and_prestretch_note: Fig. 2 gives velocity seeds but does not completely specify prestretch/Q/position reconstruction in inspected text. These set absolute displacement/domain, not shifted vector field.

analysis.passive_exclusion: For d>=0 and a1>0, Lyapunov/LaSalle gives convergence to sole equilibrium; no bounded nonstationary attractor.
analysis.active_energy_bound: For d<0, E_dot <= 8*(-d)^3/(27*a1^2). This rules out finite-time energy explosion, not a proof of an absorbing set.
analysis.planes_scope: Each is planar with regular autonomous dynamics; an aperiodic collective-chaos candidate must not be confined to either plane.
analysis.equivalence: Reflect second displacement/velocity to turn sum coupling into ordinary elastic difference coupling. This is a generalized Rayleigh pair with quadratic velocity drag, not a new oscillator mechanism.
analysis.reduction_origin: Algebra derived in this audit from source Eq. 14; not claimed as a previously unpublished theorem.

physical_limits: Externally maintained stationary temperature gradient is the energy reservoir; no finite-fuel closure imposed.
Positive fiber lengths and nonnegative tensile forces/prestretch must be checked in unshifted source coordinates; do not let compressed/slack fibers masquerade as physical trajectories.
The force formula used by the pair paper comes from the earlier small-thermal-time asymptotic constitutive relation. Its accuracy is not guaranteed at large tau or fast dynamics.
The source example has tau*sqrt(A)=0.568, so the present algebra supplies no small-error certificate.
Source Table 2 lists alpha in 0..1 although examples use -0.5; use explicit contraction sign rather than blindly sampling the table.
candidate.novelty: No exact Eq.14 chaos demonstration was verified in the bounded check. This is not proof of absence. Broad LCE/oscillator-pair chaos is established; later nonidentical/full-model publications remain incompletely checked.

secondary_screen.name: Huang et al. pressure servo valve system
secondary_screen.decision: Hold/exclude from immediate implementation; insufficient audited closure and substantial older valve-chaos literature.
secondary_screen.dimension: Not certified in this pass. At least four states in the relief subsystem (p_h,p_cj,x_j,dx_j/dt), plus pilot, feedback and cylinder dynamics; do not count a complete autonomous model from an isolated subsystem.
secondary_screen.primary_issue: Eqs.15-16 give p_h_dot=(beta/V_h)*(Q_in-k_j*p_h), while Eq.17 labels the exponential step response as p_h_dot instead of p_h. The right-hand side has pressure units, not pressure/time. Record as source consistency issue; do not silently repair all model conventions.
secondary_screen.physical_domain: Positive pressures/cavity volumes, real pressure-drop square roots, admissible spool strokes and seat/contact laws. Full source boundary rules and numerical parameter set not audited.
secondary_screen.novelty_scope: Earlier valve chaos excludes broad first-chaos claims, not necessarily exact Huang topology. No exact-model novelty assertion.
